name: status-dot
title: Status dot
description: A small colored dot with a word for a live system state: online, syncing, offline.

when: Showing a live state of a connection or system.

instead.when: The status belongs to a record (order, invoice).

builtIn: The word carries the state; the color never does alone.
youProvide: A status word, or an `aria-label` when there is no visible word.

genui.description: A dot with a word for a live state (online, syncing). Use lozenge for a record's status.
